skills.name: adversarial-verification
skills.description: Assigns independent delegates to try to refute a claim and its evidence and returns a verdict with the part that survives, when the human user or another skill calls for an adversarial review or fact-check of a numeric, legal, novelty or prior-art claim.

skills.name: agent-security-scan
skills.description: Scans the host's settings, hooks, skills, Model Context Protocol config and credential files for exposed secrets, remote fetches and side-effecting shell commands, after any of them changes or governance rules from another project are adopted, or when the human user asks to check them.
compatibility: Python 3.11+ standard library and bundled Tomli 2.4.0

skills.name: boundary-contract
skills.description: Writes a boundary contract listing the work's objective, allowed and prohibited paths and actions, acceptance criteria, phase and stop conditions, when task-router requires one.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: Resolves open design decisions, including expected behavior, asking the human user for each decision only the human user can make, and writes the design the human user accepted before implementation.

skills.name: compact-handoff
skills.description: Writes a handoff of the task's objective, scope, evidence and next action when a long conversation, compaction or handover to another session or agent could lose them, and resumes the task from it afterwards.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Assigns two or more tasks to delegates that run in parallel and combines their outputs, when no task edits a file another task reads or edits, no two share mutable state or an exclusive resource, and none needs another's output.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Executes a plan that the response model saved under writing-plans, with the response model doing every task itself, when the human user chose inline execution.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: For a branch ready to integrate, runs its locally runnable CI jobs before any push or merge and carries out the human user's choice, asking the human user if undecided: merge locally, open or merge a pull request, keep, or delete the branch.

skills.name: merge-companion
skills.description: Reviews the installer's backups of external changes to installed skills and merges each into the new skill version, discards or defers it as the human user chooses, before a task changes or reinstalls an installed skill, or when the human user asks for that review.
compatibility: Ghost-ALICE _shared folder, installed beside the skill

skills.name: necessity-gate
skills.description: Judges whether proposed work is justified, needs a narrower scope or is unjustified, when the response model proposes new work or the human user asks whether to do it.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description: When code review findings arrive, judges each against the requirements that the human user set, code and tests before changing code.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Has a delegate review the code after a major feature is built or before a merge into main, and checks that a pull request's reviews finished and CI passed on its latest commit before merging it.

skills.name: session-intent-analyzer
skills.description: Records the response model's new or changed interpretation of the input the response model is answering as its `interpreted-as` record before the first tool call of work, and reads that record when it can change the objective, constraints, work choice or whether earlier work continues.
compatibility: Ghost-ALICE _shared folder, installed beside the skill

skills.name: skill-evolution
skills.description: Recommends skill changes from recorded tool-call patterns and conduct corrections asserted by the human user or observed by the response model, when the human user asks for such recommendations or their pending backlog, or authorizes that analysis.

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.description: Executes a plan that the response model saved under writing-plans in this session by giving each task, one at a time, to a new delegate and reviewing the result, when the human user chose delegate execution and each task is self-contained.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Before a fix is proposed for a failure with an unclear cause, tests hypotheses, fixes the supported cause and counts failed fix attempts.

skills.name: task-router
skills.description: Selects the work, skills, acceptance criteria and boundary contract for a request that needs or may need a tool to change, run, analyze or verify something, or to read a remote source.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Writes a failing test before the code that makes it pass, for a feature or bug fix whose expected behavior is known and testable through the production code.

skills.name: using-coding-convention
skills.description: Before each step of development work (file read, command, edit, plan or review), loads the coding-convention skill that fits it, such as writing-plans or test-driven-development.

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Reuses or creates a git worktree when a development task that the human user's instructions authorize must run separately from the current checkout.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Before a new completion, working-fix, success or verified-status claim or a recommendation the user will act on, checks it against its acceptance criterion and evidence and decides whether evidence must be reread.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Writes an implementation plan that breaks requirements the human user accepted into tasks a newcomer to the project can carry out, after the human user settles decisions only the human user can make and the response model settles technical choices within what the human user's instructions authorize, before implementation.

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.description: Writes a new skill or changes an existing one in its folder (SKILL.md, references and scripts) and tests it.
